automationNotes: Doc: Git import path on Create New Project step 2 — Environment Variables → Connect and Import Variables (UI: data-testid connect-to-cms, legacy import-env-variables) → Stack + Delivery Token → Import Variables → Deploy; then View linked stack (Settings → Stack Integration); Update linked stack (Settings → Stack Integration → stack dropdown → Connect Stack); sync vars (Settings → Environments → first environment row → Environment Variables → Sync Stack Variables → confirm modal → Save Environment Variables). Create flow still uses Environment Name Default as in the doc modal example. Mirrors import-project-using-github through repo/branch/preset. Optional DEFAULT_STACK in .env narrows the Stack dropdown when multiple stacks are listed; Connect Stack / menu pick uses the second stack option when two or more exist. DOM: data/dom/Launch/env-environment-variable.html, env-settings-leftnav.html.
